common.confirmDelete: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

auth.registerDescription: Connect your WordPress and put content on autopilot
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.blockedDescription: Your access was suspended or terminated. If you believe this is a mistake, contact support. You can also sign in with another account.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your account email. We will send a link for you to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSentDescription: If an account exists for that email, the link will arrive shortly. It is valid for 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.
auth.resetDescription: Set the password you will use from now on.
auth.resetDoneDescription: Sign in with the new password. Sessions open on other devices were ended.
auth.resetInvalidDescription: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one to continue.
auth.verifiedDescription: Done. You can now recover access on your own if you forget your password.
auth.verifyFailedDescription: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one from the dashboard notice.
auth.unverifiedDescription: We sent a link to {email}. Confirming makes sure you can recover access if you forget your password. Your account already works normally.

billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.description: Your plan, this month's usage, and upgrades when you need more.
billing.byokNoUsageLimits: You use your own AI key, so posts and tokens have no cap — you pay the provider directly. Sites ({sites}) and autopilots ({autopilots}) stay limited: they run on our server.
billing.checkoutSuccess: Subscription confirmed! Welcome to your new plan.
billing.featSites: {count, plural, =1 {1 WordPress site} other {# WordPress sites}}
billing.notConfigured: Billing is not configured in this installation yet (set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY).
billing.freePlanHint: No credit card required. Upgrade when your blog takes off.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Track connected sites, runs, and AI costs.
overview.workerDownBody: Scheduled jobs and briefs will not be processed. In development, run pnpm dev:worker; in production, check the worker service in Docker.
overview.emptyDescription: Connect a WordPress site and create an update job to see runs here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: Interface texts. Post language is configured per site/brief.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Discovers trending topics in your niche, avoids repeating what already exists, and creates briefs on its own. You review before publishing (or go fully automatic).
autopilot.emptyDescription: Create an autopilot with your niche topics and let the system find new subjects to write about.
autopilot.discoveryQueued: Discovery started — follow it in Runs.
autopilot.topicGenerateQueued: Generation started — follow it in the run.
autopilot.topicDismissed: Topic dismissed — it will not be suggested again.
autopilot.topicDismissDescription: Dismiss "{topic}"? The pending brief is removed and the topic joins the seen-topics memory (not rediscovered).
autopilot.deleteDescription: Delete "{name}"? The run history is preserved, this config's topic feed is removed, and briefs already created remain.

briefs.title: Create posts
briefs.description: Generates new articles from a topic (brief), grounded in live web research.
briefs.emptyDescription: Create a brief with the article subject — the system researches sources, writes, and saves a draft to WordPress.
briefs.publishDescription: The draft becomes publicly visible on WordPress. Review the content first.
briefs.deleteDescription: Delete "{topic}"? The run history is preserved and the WordPress post is not affected.

jobs.title: Update posts
jobs.description: Keeps existing posts automatically up to date, by category/tag on a schedule.
jobs.emptyDescription: Create a job pointing at a site and a template to keep your posts automatically updated.
jobs.deleteDescription: Delete "{name}"? The run history is preserved.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Run history with sources, extracted data, tokens, and cost per post.
runs.emptyDescription: Create a job and use "Run now" to see the first run here.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: WordPress site connections via REST API.
sites.emptyDescription: Connect your WordPress with an application password to start automating content.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Keys and passwords encrypted with AES-256-GCM — the secret never returns to the browser.
credentials.emptyDescription: Start by saving your WordPress application password and your AI provider keys.
credentials.ownKeysNotice: Your account exclusively uses your own AI and Tavily keys (BYOK). Add them to generate content. Providers may charge for usage. Choose OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter: your choice is never automatically switched to another provider.

aiSettings.title: Active AI
aiSettings.description: Choose the provider and model used to generate text and review images. OpenAI is the primary option; Anthropic and OpenRouter remain available. Your choice only uses your own key.
aiSettings.noCredentialForProvider: Add a credential for this provider to pick a model.
aiSettings.preferOwnKeysDescription: When disabled, this super-admin workspace may use system keys. If they are missing, BYOK remains in use.
aiSettings.imageGenDescription: If no web/library image passes the quality review (resolution, watermark, another site's logo), the cover is generated with AI instead. Requires your own OpenAI credential.
aiSettings.imageGenNoCredential: Add your own OpenAI credential to enable image generation.

templates.title: Content templates
templates.description: Prompts, searches, data extraction, and managed blocks — all configurable. Clone a builtin to customize.
templates.emptyDescription: Run the database seed (pnpm db:seed) to create the builtin templates.

runDetail.title: Run from {date}
runDetail.discoveryEmpty: No new topics in this discovery (nothing trending that the blog does not already cover).
runDetail.itemsEmptyRunning: Waiting for the worker to process the posts…
runDetail.logEmpty: No log lines recorded for this run.
runDetail.retryQueued: Item re-queued — follow it in the new run.
runDetail.restoreConfirmDescription: Post #{wpPostId} goes back to the content from before this run. The change made by this run is overwritten on WordPress.
runDetail.stoppedWithQueued: Run stopped — {count} pending item(s) cancelled. The in-flight post finishes and is discarded.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Platform operations: accounts, plans and keys.
admin.statBypassHint: Granted manually by the super admin
admin.recentEmptyDescription: Every change made from the admin panel shows up here.
admin.auditDescription: Every administrative action, with author, target and change.
admin.usersDescription: Platform accounts, their workspaces and access state.
admin.usersEmptyDescription: Adjust the search or the status filter.

tracker.title: Following the run
tracker.running: You can close this panel: generation continues in the background.
tracker.doneFailed: The run finished with an error.
tracker.logEmpty: Waiting for the worker to start...
tracker.pendingBriefs: {count, plural, one {# brief awaits} other {# briefs await}} manual review
tracker.noNewTopics: No new topics this time: everything found was already covered.

error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again to keep following.
error.not_found: I could not find this run.
error.network: Lost the connection to the server. Generation continues; open the full run to check.

preview.generatingTitle: The article is still being generated
preview.generatingBody: This page refreshes on its own. When it finishes, the text and images show up here.
preview.failedBody: No error details. Open the run for the full log.
preview.postErrorTitle: Could not load the text from WordPress
preview.coverMissingBody: A cover is required, so it stayed a draft. Generate a cover with AI to be able to publish.
preview.noPost: This article has no WordPress post yet.
preview.regenerateDescription: AI creates a new image in place of this one, at the same size, and the WordPress post is updated. The old image stays in the media library.
preview.generateCoverDescription: AI creates the article cover at the size set in the template and it becomes the post featured image.
preview.regeneratePlaceholder: E.g. the app open on the chat screen, no people
preview.livePostWarning: This article is already published: the change shows on the site as soon as it finishes.
preview.reviewNone: This article did not go through the review step.
preview.reviewRejected: The review proposed changes, but they broke a text safety rule (links, numbers or structure). The original text was kept.
preview.imagesEmpty: No image was added to this article.
preview.imagesSummary: {total, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}: {generated} AI generated and {real} real.
preview.embedsEmpty: No verified video or tweet made it into this article.
